mishnah-berurah/1:ב: (2) Only with mayim shelanu — meaning overnight standing in a vessel after drawing. Rashi wrote in the Gemara: in Nissan days springs are hot because then the sun travels in the lower sky near earth and heats springs; some explain because at night the sun travels below the ground and heats springs; therefore sages forbade using them for kneading immediately upon taking from the ground [for they are like hot water forbidden for kneading as below seif 3] until they stand in vessels and cool from their heat; measure of standing in vessels and time of drawing from the well will be explained below.
mishnah-berurah/1:ד: (4) Close to bein hashemashot — l'chatchila it is fitting and proper to draw at bein hashemashot itself so water cools 12 hours attached by day when springs are cold and 12 hours in air at night; but since impossible to measure bein hashemashot precisely, permitted to draw close to bein hashemashot. One should not be lenient l'chatchila to draw much while still day — all the more so not after nightfall; nevertheless b'dieved if drawn much while still day one should not be stringent and may knead l'chatchila after overnight; see Biur Halacha. Likewise if drawn at night before chatzot, permitted to knead tomorrow l'chatchila, but must wait 12 hours from drawing.
mishnah-berurah/1:ח: (8) For the cellar is warm — if placed in cellar or heated house it will be explained below in the gloss.
mishnah-berurah/1:ט: (9) Before sunrise — lest they heat from sun's heat; it deals when water stands outside where sun rises from there; if where he cannot see the sun's face, no concern — as siman 259 seif 1 — see there; however on cloudy day in every case must be careful to bring in before sunrise hour, for a cloudy day is entirely sun.
mishnah-berurah/1:נ: (14) One should draw, etc. — per Mechaber siman 458: when 14th falls on Shabbos, kneading Friday evening is no novelty; Rama's words speak to those who bake Pesach night at Motzei Shabbos, as Tur explains there.
mishnah-berurah/1:ס: (15) Meaning Thursday night — on Friday at bein hashemashot they cannot draw, for Shabbos does not prepare for Yom Tov and bein hashemashot is Shabbos doubt; drawing while still day close to bein hashemashot is also improper lest he delay and do so on bein hashemashot [and likewise those baking second Yom Tov night forbidden at bein hashemashot of first Yom Tov, for one Yom Tov does not prepare for another and they need eve of 14th]. If forgot Thursday night, may draw Friday while still day even while day is long; all this applies to those baking many days before Pesach — when baking Sunday, l'chatchila prepare water Thursday night, b'dieved Friday while still day. If forgot to prepare while still day, may prepare at bein hashemashot via gentile; some permit even via oneself.
mishnah-berurah/1:23: (23) For matzah of the mitzvah — one says at drawing for matzah of the mitzvah [later authorities].
mishnah-berurah/1:25: (25) Wooden vessel, etc. — likewise stone or glazed earthenware (called glazed); all this specifically if used only for water; but if had fruit juice (meaning all liquids except water are called fruit juice for this) — good to be careful not to draw unless hagalah beforehand, for fruit juice mixed slightly with water hastens leavening of dough kneaded therein as siman 462; obviously proper to forbid taking large barrels that held honey, rinsing and putting water for matzot in bakeries — absolute prohibition extracting fruit juice. L'chatchila careful not to draw in copper even new because copper heats; b'dieved no concern even if water stood many days inside; even l'chatchila people practice leniency to knead in copper and are careful only not to draw water therein, for water needs one night cooling and in copper they do not cool like other vessels.
mishnah-berurah/2:ג: (28) Pressure — nevertheless if he has drawn mayim shelanu in his house, better to take them even if concern they were drawn while still day or after beginning of night. Rainwater collected from air needs no overnight, for already cooled in air through descent; however if not kneading immediately, must not place where coldness will dissipate — as above seif 1.
mishnah-berurah/5:א: (40) It is customary not to, etc. — because some say salt heats dough and thereby dough is prone to leaven.
mishnah-berurah/5:ד: (43) One should forbid — Peri Chadash disagrees and holds one should not be stringent b'dieved with little salt; appears if he was shogeg, certainly rely to be lenient. All this for eating; for benefit even per Rama permitted b'dieved.
mishnah-berurah/6:ב: (45) Valid since, etc. — from this language it implies even if only a kezayit within time to eat a meal and it has taste of matzah one fulfills; see Peri Chadash and Magen Avraham that their view is one must eat entire mealtime so there is a kezayit matzah aside from spices; see above siman 453 seif 2 in Mishna Berurah regarding mixtures of grain with other species — l'chatchila we require majority grain; likewise here.
netiv-chayim/1:_: (Taz s.k. 1) Rather the main point is there is heating by day and night. Note: incidentally he also wrote thus, for the baraita explicitly states: in rainy season the sun travels in the lower sky, therefore the whole world is cold and springs boil — see there.
peri-megadim/1:א: No Taz; he raised: whoever has doubt afterward, etc.; Magen Avraham 1 agreed with Beit Yosef's explanation; Darkei Moshe in Beit Yosef's explanation in Beit Yosef: all drawn at night, even at beginning of night, immediately forbidden with no remedy — somewhat so in Tur. One who wants to satisfy all views should draw at bein hashemashot itself.
peri-megadim/1:ב: Behold Rashi Pesachim 42a s.v. shelanu explained: in Nissan, rainy season, sun travels in lower sky and springs boil — therefore we leave overnight — end quote; the reason is explained: by day sun's heat strikes them because sun travels in lower sky near water and requires cooling — mayim shelanu, measure of average night (in Nissan day and night equal). He did not explain if drawn middle of night — perhaps permitted after six hours from detachment; all wrote for Rashi whether day or night we require 12 hours detached — whence? There is also another reason: perhaps at night sun travels under ground — not mentioned in Rashi; perhaps springs do not cool until detached 12 hours — see Levush and Rosh for Rashi leniency in river water more — I did not understand per Rashi in Gemara no distinction well and cistern; other explanation sun under ground at night — leniency in river water far from source cools in ground and attached source — Magen Avraham 6 unlike Rashi; therefore must say Rashi in responsum explained like R' Eliezer of Metz — also what Rosh wrote in Nissan sun does not travel in water — see Pesachim 94b; question what Rashi wrote in Nissan days sun travels in lower sky when 94b explains in Nissan, etc. For concern sun under ground at night as sages of nations hold Pesachim 94b — some poskim hold no remedy for all drawn at night that heated, etc.; Netziv note 1 questioned: if so no water fit for kneading, for yesterday attached in ground at night heated, etc.; one can say all that were 12 hours in ground by day cooled as Magen Avraham 1; also say drawn at night at moment of movement heats — no question from yesterday attached at night — see Magen Avraham 1; and some explain further; dispute sages of Israel and nations explained Pesachim 94b: for sages of Israel sunset is sun begins setting in sky thickness, measure of travel through sky thickness is hour minus quarter of hour — 58 and a half minutes; after this measure bein hashemashot begins — 13 and a half minutes; total hour and fifth as explained Minchat Kohen Maamar Sheini ch. 2 32a; for sages of nations sunset is beginning to set under horizon, travel through earth thickness is sunset, then bein hashemashot as above; Taz wrote under sky — typo, should be under ground as sages of nations and Beit Yosef; see Levush 61 wrote 11 springs always boil — for Rashi as we wrote. One afraid to satisfy all views should draw precisely at bein hashemashot — time 13 and a half minutes after hour minus quarter from sunset beginning; knead after morning light only if full 12 hours detached passed — otherwise in leap year when night sometimes not long, forbidden until full 12 hours per Rashi; if night longer than 12 hours, forbidden before day per R' Yehuda bar Natan as said — Bach; see note 2 and Magen Avraham explained further.
peri-megadim/2:_: L'chatchila Taz; Magen Avraham notes 6 and 11 — Rashi Pesachim 42a explained in Nissan rainy season — great question, for 94b explains opposite — see note 1 here; main distinction between rivers: since far from source already cooled, unlike spring where sun travels at night, etc. — see there; so Magen Avraham explains further.
peri-megadim/4:_: Iron Taz. Salt helps for tekufah — see Yoreh De'ah 116; Peri Chadash end seif 5; in mayim shelanu forbidden to put our salt water in the water, for fruit juice with water hastens leavening — siman 464 and 472 in Magen Avraham 7 explained there. Forbidden for gentile to draw for matzah of mitzvah — Peri Chadash wrote reason: preparers of mitzvah like mitzvah as siman 464; b'dieved permitted; when drawing say for matzah of mitzvah — Ateret Zekenim notes 8-9; see Magen Avraham 16 there. Darkei Moshe wrote iron or sealing with cloth — when sealing with cloth no permission to damage as we find all drawn and sealed, etc.; Rama wrote 28 months; wooden vessel no need to be particular — Magen Avraham 10; Levush seif 7 requires some study.
peri-megadim/5:_: Cistern Taz wrote meaning close to drawing; so Levush — apparently when lenient in pressure it is drawn close to bein hashemashot; for Mechaber seif 1 while still day and did not stand 12 hours, then lenient in pressure — for R' Eliezer of Metz when drawn at bein hashemashot permitted immediately, unlike drawing beginning of night per R' Eliezer of Metz no remedy forever per second explanation in Beit Yosef — therefore do not rely on this even in cistern in pressure; nevertheless in pressure all permit. Ateret Zekenim 11; Eliyah Rabbah 6: cistern or pipe called ra'er or hole at source — perhaps ra'er water nullified with cistern water — Magen Avraham 15; see Magen Avraham 11. Those wells with ra'er in houses where they brew beer and honey and put always dirty honey-beer vessels in well — prevent drawing from well, for honey is fruit juice; some say not nullified in 1000 — siman 462; Tur prefers drawing from pipe ra'er to put vessel there and drip there.
peri-megadim/6:א: Even Taz: first night if only water not left overnight, may l'chatchila knead to fulfill eating matzah mitzvah; appears same second night although moon fixes differently, both days one law — requires study perhaps not; although obligated to eat bread — Magen Avraham 488:9 whether Torah or rabbinic — see there.
peri-megadim/6:ב: Beit Yosef wrote Taz needs explanation. Mordechai chapter Kol Sha'ah 493: incident Pesach Sunday, tekufah also fell night before; nevertheless not concerned, kneaded with water drawn at night; R' Yehuda HaChasid wrote no need to be concerned "keeper of mitzvah"; all baked only for next day, for Yom Tov does not prepare for fellow; second night too only for that day, not preparing for weekday. Per this text: nevertheless not concerned for tekufah fallen Motzei Shabbos night, drew at bein hashemashot Motzei Shabbos as mayim shelanu and thought no prohibition in drawing, did not discard water, kneaded for day 1; likewise second night; they also hold when Pesach Sunday bake Pesach night lest matzah become stale — siman 458 Taz 1; R' Yehuda HaChasid not arguing but said they did well not discarding — keeper of mitzvah; this is Beit Yosef's language; simple they mean as those who say bake Pesach night itself — if bake Motzei Shabbos after chatzot not relevant; even per bake Pesach night wonder why not draw Friday; perhaps hold such not mayim shelanu; still wonder though tekufah fell Thursday night how permitted draw Shabbos for Yom Tov; you will say drawing not great exertion permitted; if so when tekufah fell Thursday night why concerned; they should draw Friday bein hashemashot; further wonder tekufah: once three hours passed not tekufah hour; we concern only drinking at tekufah hour; perhaps all detached at tekufah harms afterward — end quote. Words hard to fit if text Thursday night; if text night before (mistakenly moved hei from b-lail) or explain Beit Yosef: tekufah fell Motzei Shabbos night because Pesach Sunday — "night before" means Motzei Shabbos; drew Motzei Shabbos bein hashemashot with sunset as Beit Yosef beginning per R' Eliezer of Metz; simple for those who bake Pesach night — if not bake Motzei Shabbos after chatzot, already drew Thursday night belonging to Friday and baked, etc.; they also hold R' Eliezer of Metz if drawn close to sunset permitted immediately, not 12 hours unlike Rashi; R' Yehuda HaChasid said well done not discarding — keeper of mitzvah; Beit Yosef asked why not draw Friday day instead bein hashemashot Motzei Shabbos; answer perhaps hold all drawn by day no remedy with 12 hours waiting (still wonder better Thursday night bein hashemashot than Motzei Shabbos bein hashemashot); further asked should draw Friday bein hashemashot lighter and not Motzei Shabbos where prohibition fixed — see Magen Avraham in Mishna Berurah shevut permitted bein hashemashot if specifically Erev Shabbos not Motzei — see there; therefore text should be tekufah fell and delete she-lamed; heaven forbid I emend and delete she-lamed.
peri-megadim/6:ג: Bach's words require study — he too explains Beit Yosef had text tekufa night before — Motzei Shabbos as here; however what he wrote there they needed water for second Pesach night — although Yom Tov does not prepare for fellow, they should also for Yom Tov 1 — some imply they drew and waited 12 hours; then night 1 Pesach whence water; therefore drew Thursday night bein hashemashot belonging to Friday; further per conclusion all detached harms water for day 1 — should explain drew for day 1 after Motzei Shabbos bein hashemashot immediately at night beginning before springs boil per R' Eliezer of Metz and knead immediately as Tur there. Bach asked why discuss tekufah fell Motzei Shabbos bein hashemashot nevertheless not concerned, drew immediately after sunset and kneaded immediately per R' Eliezer of Metz — if tekufah not fallen they would draw Motzei Shabbos bein hashemashot as mayim shelanu l'chatchila precisely; R' Yehuda HaChasid disagrees said not well — should draw Motzei Shabbos bein hashemashot keeper of mitzvah; Bach asked since tekufah fell they draw Motzei Shabbos bein hashemashot now too; answer all detached harms — therefore waited after tekufah passed. Taz not satisfied with many difficulties as written; therefore other explanation; Mordechai text Thursday night; Rokeach Thursday night belonging to Friday; doubtful same — sometimes call Thursday night night of 5 belonging to 6 as Rama Thursday night Magen Avraham 4; what Shabbos 9 implies apparently baked Motzei Shabbos after chatzot as siman 461; tekufah Thursday night belonging to Friday; not concerned water detached at tekufah, no iron; R' Yehuda HaChasid said well done — concludes Mordechai incident; all baked only for night 1 — Motzei Shabbos not Motzei; Pesach Sunday; Shabbos 9 proof.
peri-megadim/6:ד: Taz explained Mordechai text tekufah night before means Thursday night; "before" literally for Bach meant Sunday; reconcile Rokeach second night belonging to Thursday; they doubted because tekufah after bein hashemashot how draw at tekufah hour — danger; nevertheless not concerned, kneaded with water drawn at night — drew immediately after tekufah; R' Yehuda HaChasid said well done; Beit Yosef challenged: still hard how depends on tekufah — without tekufah how permitted draw Thursday night for Yom Tov; answer drawing not great exertion permitted only because tekufah Thursday night they doubted and not concerned tekufah; we are Thursday night — should draw Friday bein hashemashot better precisely l'chatchila and not violate tekufah preparation; final answer only on last question, etc. Know "kneaded with water drawn at night" — word "at night" separates "drawn" — meaning drawn at bein hashemashot as law kneaded Pesach night. Taz Mordechai text Pesach Sunday tekufah night before — night before Pesach whether Thursday or Friday; Rokeach explains Thursday night 6 — only difference drew as law Thursday night as gloss seif 1 and baked Pesach night — they hold so siman 458; although water detached not concerned, baked, R' Yehuda HaChasid said well; all difficulties from Beit Yosef Shabbos how drew, etc.; but difficulty detached harms — Thursday night certainly no drawing as Rokeach like filling garden siman 338 (typo should be night before and Shabbos no draw); if tekufah relevance — Pesach other days detached knead Motzei after chatzot; rather "also" teaches Taz if drew Thursday night after tekufah one matter — two laws as said. Nevertheless Friday night bein hashemashot shevut bein hashemashot place of mitzvah Magen Avraham 4 only Shabbos no draw; Eliyah Rabbah 17 agrees Taz; drawn Thursday night means bein hashemashot; some erred baked by day meaning Motzei because mitzvah beloved in its time proper Motzei.
rabbi-akiva-eiger/2:_: Magen Avraham s.k. 1 "in this all agree" — meaning Beit Yosef agrees with R' Eliyahu Mizrachi that per R' Eliyahu Mizrachi's approach no remedy; but when drawn by day Beit Yosef disputes Mizrachi and holds even for R' Eliyahu Mizrachi there is remedy to wait until after night — see there.
rabbi-akiva-eiger/3:_: Seif 3: whether water not left overnight forbidden. Bach wrote it appears from Or Zarua's words: all who say if one transgressed and kneaded, forbidden — in eating; in benefit permitted even hot — end quote.
shaarei-teshuvah/1:_: For bein hashemashot. Baer Heitev; see Peri Chadach siman 259 seif 5: although Yoreh De'ah 36 when stood somewhat in house called lukewarm, nevertheless mayim shelanu are very cold; if heated like saliva warmth or like summer river water, has status of lukewarm and burn immediately — end quote; see Beit Efrayim on treifot in responsa compendium siman 80 length on this; explained there only when standing in house in summer we are particular, not Nissan days when Rashi Pesachim still rainy season, etc. — see there; may say whatever heated somewhat even not like saliva, do not knead — see there; concern this and place in cold place lest come to heat at all; see Mor VeKetzia in our northern lands in Nissan it is cold time, be lenient b'dieved water not left overnight in pressure — see there; appears all per posek's eyes per time and season.
shaarei-teshuvah/4:_: Thursday night Baer Heitev; see responsum Beit Efrayim siman 32: one who wants bake Sunday because Sunday has advantage in fitness — table and vessels cleanest, Motzei Shabbos everything washed well, hagalah and whitening working vessels; helpers in kneading and rolling, even hands cooled and strength renewed by Shabbos rest — this is need of mitzvah; lenient to permit drawing water Friday even if time of bein hashemashot arrived; close to bein hashemashot permit even without this fitness advantage — see there; see Beit Yehuda siman 57 also permits draw Friday and advance somewhat before bein hashemashot; see there if left under open sky permitted bring morning because sun — not without need, like preparing for weekday since fit to drink today and good drink some — see there; Beit Yehuda 108 in name of Maharash Zur permitted draw via gentile Shabbos bein hashemashot; so practiced Chida 87 — requires study.
shaarei-teshuvah/5:_: Iron. Baer Heitev on Beit Yosef's words; see Eliyah Rabbah there and responsum Beit Efrayim siman 32 — I wrote correct explanation of Beit Yosef's words with God's help — see there.
turei-zahav/2:_: L'chatchila one should draw, etc. Rashi wrote main stringency of water not left overnight is in springs and cisterns that boil, but not rivers — in Nissan sun does not travel in water, but sages were concerned for most towns that have only cistern and spring water; R' Avigdor wrote this is nothing, for even flowing rivers sun strikes by day and heats them; therefore better l'chatchila to draw from river when possible.
turei-zahav/3:_: One should not discard, etc. Reason in Mordechai: night of guarding is for Thursday; also wrote even other Pesach nights "He guards the simple" — heaven forbid mishap in mitzvah matzot — end quote; nevertheless appears other nights he may discard if easily without those waters, unlike night before Pesach which are for matzah of mitzvah — forbidden to discard, contemptuous of mitzvah, showing he holds mitzvah does not protect from mishap and verse "keeper of mitzvah knows no evil" is light in his eyes.
turei-zahav/5:_: Cistern. Room built beneath and around — they are as collected in a vessel and do not boil from sun traveling under ground, for building separates from ground; but Beit Yosef reported: these waters in winter are hot like well water; therefore do not be lenient unless pressure — meaning close to drawing.
turei-zahav/6:_: Even without pressure, etc. R' Eliyahu Mizrachi, Semag, and Semak permit even l'chatchila when impossible otherwise; appears first night one may rely so as not to nullify eating matzah mitzvah since b'shogeg permitted; not other days — eat other things. Beit Yosef brought Mordechai: incident Pesach Sunday, tekufah fell Thursday night before; nevertheless not concerned, kneaded with water drawn at night; R' Yehuda HaChasid wrote no concern — keeper of mitzvah; Mordechai after: baked only for day 1, Yom Tov does not prepare for fellow; Rokeach brought this law but there writes tekufa fell Thursday night only. It appears he understood tekufa fell Shabbos night, drew at night, baked Motzei matzah — night 1 Pesach; thus Mordechai explained; they did not want draw Motzei night per Rashi requiring 12 hours always, not concerned tekufa at drawing hour; R' Yehuda HaChasid said well done keeper of mitzvah — implies bake Pesach night when Sunday; otherwise only Motzei bake no place for Mordechai; Beit Yosef further even so Mordechai not settled — wonder why crossed tekufa danger, not draw Friday day; answered perhaps hold by day no remedy per R' Eliyahu Mizrachi and Mizrachi — Beit Yosef; perhaps hold such not mayim shelanu — Mizrachi; Bach asked why concerned Shabbos drawing tekufa — implies without tekufa no doubt; even without, Shabbos drawing prohibition; you will say such permitted Shabbos — then how draw afterward at night; why concerned tekufa at all since not at kneading hour; answered hold all water detached at tekufah hour dangerous even after — not answering other questions to explain Beit Yosef per his understanding. Mahari Weil other explanation per Beit Yosef — I did not reconcile; truth in Mordechai unlike Beit Yosef: drew Motzei Friday night only after drawing that night or Shabbos night tekufa — no difference; why Mordechai wrote Thursday night not Thursday 6: drew as law Motzei Friday bein hashemashot, baked Yom Tov night — teaches two laws: tekufah does not harm what they kneaded for mitzvah though passed in detached; second that night baked only for Yom Tov 1 — two laws independent, both occurred — therefore Mordechai wrote also fell, etc., another novelty there; Shabbos obviously no drawing as Rokeach like filling garden end Eruvin — all Bach's questions inapplicable — in my humble opinion.
